event: Bute arrangement with Daniel Thomas & Son over the house/quarry holding; Bute keeps the eastern fields
wording_or_terms: Mary (Nancy) Williams c.1974: "The freehold of the greater part of the farm consisting of the farmhouse and buildings and about 10 acres ... was sold by the Bute Estate to Daniel Thomas and another portion consisting of about 9 acres up on the top was retained by the Bute Estate."
occupier_response: n/a
legal_effect: Unknown: sale or quarry lease; instrument not located
later_consequence: Basis of the 1928 documentary-title route

event: Bute yearly agricultural tenancy to John Williams
A2_farmhouse_garden: included on the court record ("the whole of the farm")
wording_or_terms: "a yearly agricultural tenancy of the whole of the farm" (Court of Appeal recital)
occupier_response: Rent paid; arrears mid-1930s and late 1940s (court record)
legal_effect: If it included the house, the Williams occupation of A2 was as Bute's (later WGR's) tenant
later_consequence: Strongest record against both family title routes; reused in 1949 and 1955 wording
category: established by primary record (recital in judgment); plan not seen

event: Quarrying ends (by Nov 1925, archive record); last rent of about £4 to Alfred Thomas (1928, family account)
C_south_green: not in Parcel A on current model
legal_effect: Family case: 1877 arrangement takes effect; alternative: 12-year clock against the Thomas title starts at last rent
later_consequence: 1940 limitation date
category: quarry end: established by primary record (DSA/12/4888); 1928 rent: supported by testimony

event: Conveyance on sale of Bute reversion to Western Ground Rents Ltd (WGR)
wording_or_terms: Root of WGR title in its 1965 school-site contract: "a Conveyance on sale dated 25th December 1938"
legal_effect: WGR acquires whatever Bute still owned; nothing more
later_consequence: Every later corporate title to A1/A2 depends on this deed and plan
category: established by primary record (recital); extent unresolved

event: WGR written monthly tenancy to John Williams, 5.30 acres at 8s, with plan
A2_farmhouse_garden: not included ("does not make any mention of the farmhouse")
wording_or_terms: "agricultural land adjacent to Ty-Mawr farmhouse"
occupier_response: Signed; the signature is questioned (not checked)
legal_effect: Tenancy of Parcel B only; whether it superseded the 1916 tenancy is untested
later_consequence: Absent from the 1987 judgment

event: Surrender of John Williams's tenancy; new unwritten yearly tenancy to Frederick Buckler
A2_farmhouse_garden: court treated it as included; family case: not included
wording_or_terms: Never put in writing; agents 10 Oct 1952: "did not propose to proceed with the letting"
occupier_response: Family case: an attempt to make Mary's Parcel A occupation look permissive, refused (no record found of an offer to Mary in 1949)
legal_effect: Court: Frederick held a protected periodic tenancy; his possession of A2 counted as tenant until 2 Feb 1955
later_consequence: Basis of 1955 notice to quit and order
category: tenancy: established (court record); Parcel A content: unresolved

event: Family title papers removed from the farmhouse blanket box (lodger placed by a Penarth agent)
occupier_response: Reported missing 1950-52
legal_effect: Loss of documentary proof of the 1928 route
later_consequence: Court 1987: "No such documents were, however, ever produced."
who_gained: any party opposing the Williams title (inference only)
category: loss: supported by testimony; remover: unresolved

event: Reported further attempt to place Frederick Buckler in the position of a tenant
A2_farmhouse_garden: family case: aimed at Parcel A occupation
wording_or_terms: Original source not attached; the 1987 judgment does not mention 1954
occupier_response: Unsuccessful (family chronology)
legal_effect: None recorded

event: Last rent by Frederick (under a judgment for arrears, 1953); notice to quit expires 2 Feb 1955
legal_effect: Court: joint adverse possession of A2 by Frederick and Mary from 2 Feb 1955
later_consequence: 12-year date 2 Feb 1967 (cut off by the 1962 action)

event: High Court Order 14 possession order against Frederick alone, "whole of the farm"; enforced except farmhouse and garden
A1_woodland: taken (court: all parts except farmhouse and garden); polygon not mapped
A2_farmhouse_garden: not enforced (Mary had just lost a leg; objected strongly)
C_south_green: taken if within "the farm"; polygon not mapped
wording_or_terms: "possession was taken in respect of all parts of the farm except the farmhouse and garden"
occupier_response: Mary stayed in A2
legal_effect: Possession order against a tenant: an enforcement right, not a conveyance of any estate
later_consequence: WGR in physical possession of A1, B and (probably) C from 4 Jul 1955
what_authority_was_told: High Court told the tenancy covered the whole farm
category: established by primary record (judgment); exact polygons unresolved

event: Mrs M. D. Buckler speaks at the Leckwith Common inquiry and to the county planning committee
other_parties: Glamorgan County Council (later the commons registration authority)
wording_or_terms: "It's a Crichel Down"
occupier_response: Public assertion of family title
legal_effect: None on title; puts the county council on notice of a Williams/Buckler ownership assertion
later_consequence: Same council registered VG41 in 1970
what_authority_was_told: Council told of an ownership assertion

event: WGR offers Mary a tenancy of the farmhouse and garden
wording_or_terms: "She was offered a tenancy of the farmhouse and garden by Western Ground Rents but refused to accept it."
occupier_response: Refused; asserted title through her grandfather
legal_effect: None: an unaccepted offer creates no tenancy and no acknowledgment
later_consequence: WGR turns to proceedings (1962)
category: established by primary record (judgment); exact date and wording unresolved

event: Deed between WGR, South Western Brick & Tile and Cardiff City
other_parties: South Western Brick & Tile; Cardiff City Corporation
A1_woodland: burdens pink land now in WA735527 (rights, not a transfer)
wording_or_terms: Register: pink land "subject to" the 1905 and 1961 deeds
legal_effect: Not a registration and not a transfer of the woodland to Cardiff: the burdened land stayed with WGR and passed to BP in 1969/1982
later_consequence: Recited on the WA231076 first-registration file
category: existence: established by primary record; content: unresolved

event: Cardiff County Court possession order (farmhouse and garden) and mesne profits since 1955
wording_or_terms: Judge Temple Morris QC
occupier_response: Not enforced; suspended committal against Frederick June 1963
legal_effect: Stops the limitation clock for WGR and successors; 12 years to enforce (to 11 Dec 1974); not an estate in land
later_consequence: Revived by BP Pension Trust in Sep 1974

event: WGR agents offer "Mrs Williams" a (weekly) tenancy
wording_or_terms: Frederick complained WGR had refused to let him the land
occupier_response: Refused
legal_effect: None on title; used at trial against Frederick's intention to possess
later_consequence: Trial judge: no animus possidendi for Frederick (overruled on appeal)

event: Frederick Buckler dies; Mary in sole possession of A2
legal_effect: BP admitted Mary was in adverse possession from this death until 31 Oct 1974

event: WGR conveys Great House Farm, including the farmhouse and garden, to BP Pension Trust Ltd
wording_or_terms: Deed not on either HMLR schedule; recited as root in both BP conveyances
legal_effect: Passes WGR's paper title (whatever it was) and the benefit of the 1962 order
later_consequence: BPPT enforces the 1962 order "as successors in title"
category: established by primary record (recital); extent unresolved

event: VG41 entered in the register of town and village greens (Commons Registration Act 1965)
initiated_by: registration authority (Glamorgan County Council); applicant unknown
C_south_green: registered as green (polygon match with Parcel C unresolved)
wording_or_terms: Statutory test: allotment, custom, or 20 years' use as of right (s.22(1)); objections 1 May 1970 to 31 Jul 1972
occupier_response: No objection found
legal_effect: Registers public recreational status; ownership is a separate register section
later_consequence: Green outside BP titles on current model
what_authority_was_told: unknown until the register sheet is read
category: registration: established; applicant, map and owner: unresolved

event: Abstract of title for BP Pension Trust
wording_or_terms: Lodged at first registration (HMLR)
legal_effect: Evidence of title, not a transfer
later_consequence: Basis of the 1982/83 "no question or doubt" certificate

event: BP Pension Trust county court possession action against Mary (as Mrs Williams) and family; adjourned part-heard for a defence
wording_or_terms: Defence: BPPT barred by adverse possession (Limitation Act 1939); family record: plea of ownership
occupier_response: Ownership and limitation asserted
legal_effect: Never finally heard
later_consequence: A live plea at the date of first registration
what_authority_was_told: County court told of her plea

event: BPPT applies on two days' notice for leave to enforce the 1962 order; leave given 19 Sep, warrant not to be enforced until 31 Oct 1974
wording_or_terms: "as successors in title to Western Ground Rents"
occupier_response: Notice of appeal 30 Oct; stay application listed 4 Nov; press campaign
legal_effect: Enforcement still open (12 years to 11 Dec 1974)
later_consequence: Letters of 31 Oct 1974

event: Two letters: BPPT (sale to BP Properties; bailiff instructions withdrawn) and BP Properties (rent free for life)
A2_farmhouse_garden: "house and garden rent free for as long as you may wish and for the rest of your life"
wording_or_terms: "I do hope that by making this gesture you will accept the situation"
occupier_response: Never accepted or rejected; solicitors advised her to do nothing until 11 Dec 1974 passed
legal_effect: Court of Appeal: from receipt she possessed "by the licence of BP Properties Ltd"; adverse possession stopped (s.10(2) LA 1939)
later_consequence: Decisive in 1987
what_authority_was_told: Letters produced to the county court 4 Nov 1974; warrant withdrawn before 25 Nov

event: BPPT (with BP Trustees) conveys the farmhouse plot "and other land" (blue land) to BP Properties; rest of the farm retained
wording_or_terms: Retained Land; reserved rights for roads and services to serve development of the Retained Land; light and air enjoyed "by the temporary and revocable licence only of the Vendors"
legal_effect: BP Properties acquires the paper title BPPT held; six months before compulsory registration (1 Dec 1975), so no duty to register
later_consequence: Root of WA240304
who_gained: BPPT kept the development land; BP Properties took the occupied house
sources: GHF-E138; EV-0052; WA231076 and WA735527 registers; R10; EV-0265

event: BPPT and BP Trustees convey the retained land to BP Properties; first registration WA231076 (form 1E)
wording_or_terms: Solicitors certified no question or doubt affecting the title; 1971 abstract lodged
legal_effect: Compulsory first registration within 11 days; title absolute (current register)
later_consequence: Main title

event: Voluntary first registration WA240304 (form 1C) on the 1975 conveyance: farmhouse and garden
wording_or_terms: Statutory declaration and certificate not yet read
occupier_response: Mary in actual occupation; dies 26 Mar 1983 (31 days later)
legal_effect: Any right of an occupier was an overriding interest (LRA 1925 s.70(1)(g)); the court later accepted that a matured possessory title would have bound BP
later_consequence: Linklaters/HMLR letters 8 and 12 Apr 1983; reported notice after her death
what_authority_was_told: unresolved (the key test of the licence-attribution question)
category: application: established; content of declaration: unresolved

event: High Court (Hollis J, Cardiff): possessory title by adverse possession not made out; possession ordered
A1_woodland: rest of farm: not challenged on appeal
occupier_response: Appeal limited to farmhouse and garden
legal_effect: Possession judgment
later_consequence: Appeal

event: Amalgamation of WA240304 into WA231076 requested while the appeal was pending
wording_or_terms: Application not yet read
occupier_response: No record of notice to the appellant
legal_effect: Administrative: one register for both strands
later_consequence: Court of Appeal describes BP as registered "since November 1982" for the whole farm

event: Court of Appeal (Dillon LJ; Mustill LJ and Sir Edward Eveleigh agreeing) dismisses appeal
A2_farmhouse_garden: possession to BP in six weeks
wording_or_terms: "from the time of her receipt of the letters, Mrs Buckler was in possession of the farmhouse and garden by the licence of BP Properties Ltd"
occupier_response: House of Lords leave refused (by CA); petition papers at TNA
legal_effect: Decides limitation and licence only; paper title assumed
later_consequence: Eviction 1988

event: Forced entry and eviction; house demolished at night
occupier_response: ECHR application 14464/88, inadmissible 14 Apr 1989
legal_effect: Possession recovered
later_consequence: Development

event: Later dealings: Oakview part sale (1989); BP to Ideal Homes (3 Dec 1993; Persimmon Homes (Wales) on register from 20 Jan 1994); woodland to Forest of Cardiff (10 Nov 1994); SWEB rights (28 Jun 1995); woodland part to Goldsworthy Homes (transfer 2 Dec 2005, entered 22 Dec 2005; £20,000 in accounts)
other_parties: Ideal Homes / Persimmon; Forest of Cardiff; Goldsworthy Homes
legal_effect: Registered dispositions for value
later_consequence: Purchaser protection now central to any remedy
